ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; surface is dominated by high-intensity (white) pixels with a sharp transition to low-intensity (black) pixels along the distal trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous mass covers approximately 90% of the visible ventral area. A thick, continuous black band forms the perimeter of the trailing edge. Minor low-intensity pixel clusters are localized in the central-right region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extensive, high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 3-10 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curves extending symmetrically from the median notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of yellowish-brown and high-contrast white circular pixel groups localized on the leftmost distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustation (barnacle colony) on the left fluke tip; irregular edge morphology on the right distal margin.
